title: Understand. Design. Build.
subtitle: Untameable helps you identify bottlenecks, design practical solutions, and turn them into working software.
goal: The goal is simple: improve efficiency and create business value.

solutionArchitecture.title: Solution Architecture
solutionArchitecture.text: Turning complex requirements into clear, practical technical solutions. From system design and technology choices to integration strategies.

forwardDeployed.title: Forward Deployed Engineering
forwardDeployed.text: Working closely with your team to understand challenges, validate ideas, and build solutions directly into your existing workflows.

softwareEngineering.title: Software Engineering
softwareEngineering.text: Designing, developing, and maintaining applications, platforms, and integrations. Built for usability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.

approach.title: How we work
approach.intro: From understanding the problem to delivering a working solution.

understand.title: Understand
understand.text: Explore the business, its workflows, and the challenges worth solving. Identify opportunities and define what success looks like.

design.title: Design
design.text: Translate findings into a practical technical solution. Validate assumptions, explore alternatives, and build prototypes where needed.

build.title: Build
build.text: Develop and integrate the solution into existing systems and workflows. Focus on usability, reliability, and maintainability.

improve.title: Improve
improve.text: Evaluate results, gather feedback, and refine what has been built. Keep improving where it adds value.

philosophy.title: Do what works.
philosophy.intro: Good software starts with understanding the problem, not choosing the technology.

simple.title: Keep it simple
simple.text: Avoid unnecessary complexity. Build what's needed, using technology that fits the problem.

together.title: Work together
together.text: Stay close to the people who understand the business. Good solutions come from combining technical expertise with practical knowledge.

practice.title: Make it work
practice.text: Ideas and architecture matter, but the real value comes from solutions that work in practice.

about.title: Behind Untameable
paragraphs: Untameable is a small, independent software engineering company founded by Edgar Ravenhorst.
With over 10 years of experience in software development and solution architecture, the focus is on understanding complex problems and turning them into practical solutions.
Projects are approached hands-on, combining technical expertise with direct collaboration. When needed, additional developers and specialists are brought in.
No unnecessary layers. Just the right people working on the right solution.

contact.title: Let's talk.
contact.text: Have a challenge, an idea, or a project that needs a practical solution? Get in touch.
